snippet.title: Remaining Grace — Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/4954540

Remaining Grace is an intimate non-linear ghost story about chosen family, human connections, and the mosaic of quiet moments that bind them.

Move through the world as Grace's wandering spirit. Enter her loved ones through the happenstance of human touch. Inhabit their perspectives across three time periods, weaving a bigger picture between private worlds to explore a multi-layered tale only the dead could tell. Witness a beautiful web of complex relationships before they too disappear forever.

As a small indie studio, wishlists on Steam help us out a lot!
If Remaining Grace seems interesting to you, please consider wishlisting our game: https://s.team/a/4954540
